description: Evaluate a repo's commits against its .madeby/policy.json disclosure policy (the maintainer gate). Returns pass/fail, the policy mode, and the undisclosed commits. The policy file is optional — with no file (or an invalid one) it degrades to advisory (report-only, never a false gate).

path.description: path to the repo (default: the server's working directory)

range.description: git commit range, e.g. origin/main..HEAD (default: recent history)

name: check
